# doaa: seeds for the SCSP sound board's 68000 (m2sndrecomp --scsp).
# Addresses only, our own analysis (rules.md rule 7). The program dispatches
# through five tables of "jmp (d16,pc)" entries, 4 bytes each, each right after
# a "lea (d8,pc,Dn),An; jmp (An)"; every entry of each table is a seed:
# 0x601b80 (16), 0x602b3c (81), 0x6036d6 (16), 0x603728 (16), 0x603ebe (16).
# With them every one of the 2,187 addresses MAME's 68000 executed in 3,600
# frames of attract (M2TRACE_SNDPCS) is recompiled.
